items.stem: Match LIST-I with LIST-II. LIST-I (tests): A. Chi-square test; B. Wilcoxon signed-rank test; C. Mann–Whitney U test; D. Kruskal–Wallis test. LIST-II (purpose): I. Homogeneity or independence in a contingency table; II. Several independent samples: rank version of one-way ANOVA; III. Two independent samples; IV. Two related (paired) samples. Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
items.explanation: Match each test to the design or question it answers: Chi-square test → Homogeneity or independence in a contingency table; Wilcoxon signed-rank test → Two related (paired) samples; Mann–Whitney U test → Two independent samples; Kruskal–Wallis test → Several independent samples: rank version of one-way ANOVA. So the matching is A-I, B-IV, C-III, D-II. Trap: each item of LIST-II is used exactly once, so fix the pairs you are sure of first.
